name: CA35
description:
## Description

"Vacuum tube stereo preamplifier with 3-pole tube configuration for all stages.The amplifier stage consists of a phono equalizer amplifier and a line amplifier, each of which uses highly reliable twin triodes. The circuit structure is a 3-stage K-K feedback type amplifier, with two ECC-83and one ECC-82in the equalizer amplifier section and three ECC-82in the line amplifier section for DC ignition operation.Equipped with MC cartridge booster transformer."
